integrity: The proof is analytic for all positive shore sizes. Exhaustive partition enumeration on small bicliques and construction checks on larger parameters are corroborative only. Literature comparisons distinguish the initiating coalition invariant from nearby locating-total, self-locating, solid-locating, and ordinary locating-domination results.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to complete bipartite graphs and to ordinary locating-dominating coalitions. It does not classify complete multipartite graphs with three or more parts or other locating variants.
title: Locating-dominating coalition numbers of complete bipartite graphs
